nodes.text:
Market Update! 

The fear surrounding the HMPV virus, along with weak deposit and credit growth and the depreciation of the rupee, is impacting the market. Concerns over a potential market crash are causing retail investors to sell their shares.

nodes.author: Ichimokuin8213
nodes.text: This downturn, largely triggered by foreign institutional investors, has created panic among retail participants. Even mutual fund investors, who usually have a long-term perspective, are considering exiting their investments due to fear, which is not a healthy trend.

nodes.author: Ichimokuin8213
nodes.text:
The frequent market fluctuations have eroded investor confidence, prompting many to shift their focus to gold and fixed deposits.
    Investors should not panic, especially when holding shares or mutual funds with a long-term perspective.

nodes.author: Ichimokuin8213
nodes.text: It’s worth remembering that after the COVID-19 crash, the market rebounded and reached lifetime highs within a year or two. Let this serve as a reminder to ignore the noise. Stay committed to your investment goal keep your confidence intact, and remain invested for the long term.
